drafted_from: tool:answer-questions-about-a-state row in tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/tool-rows.json, its code in tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ and tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/test/answer-state-questions.test.mjs and tool.test.mjs; the answers were produced by running the tool against a stand-in model server
start_here: Say to your AI: "Answer these three questions about the state {customer: table 4} with my local chat model: is the order late, which loaf, how rushed." It sends them in one request and reports each answer under its question.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it sends one state and its typed questions to a model server on this computer and prints the answers.
instructions: 1. Write the questions as an object by id: {type: "noul" (a number 0 to 1) | "choice" (with criteria naming the options) | "score" (a number), instructions}.

3. Say "Answer these questions about the state". The AI reads the row with tools:list and runs: node tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ask-a-small-model.mjs answer-state-questions < /work/judge/request.json.
4. Read result.answers: each question id with an answer in its type. A reply that leaves a question out or answers in the wrong type is refused with the question named.

worked_examples.title: Three typed questions about a bakery order in one request
worked_examples.ask: Answer these questions about the order for table 4.
worked_examples.given: From tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/test/tool.test.mjs (test "answer-state-questions: every question comes back in its type..."), run for real against a stand-in chat server that replies {"urgent": 0.9, "kind": "rye", "rush": 3}: request {"state": {"customer": "table 4"}, "questions": {"urgent": {"type": "noul", "instructions": "Is the order late?"}, "kind": {"type": "choice", "instructions": "Which loaf?", "criteria": {"rye": "dark", "white": "light"}}, "rush": {"type": "score", "instructions": "How rushed, 0 to 5?"}}, "endpoint": "http://127.0.0.1:11434", "model": "stand-in", "timeout_seconds": 30}. Command: node tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ask-a-small-model.mjs answer-state-questions < /work/judge/request.json
worked_examples.hands_back: Last line: {"result": {"model": "stand-in", "answers": {"urgent": 0.9, "kind": "rye", "rush": 3}}}. If the reply left out rush the answer is {"error": "... answer to question rush is missing ..."}; if urgent came back as 7 it is refused as "question urgent is not a number from 0 to 1".
